title: An anchored picture keeps its posOffset X when it runs past the column into the margin, is pulled back only to the paper edge, and is never displaced by another side-wrapped picture it overlaps
source: build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf image bboxes; A4 1440 margins (column 72..523.3), Calibri 11, 207 x 129 pt pictures at paragraph posOffset 6.5 pt, distL/distR 9 pt, one case per page

cases.note: margin posOffset 293 pt wrapSquare: 48.7 pt into the right margin, text beside it ends at 356
margin posOffset 400 pt would leave the paper: pulled back to the paper edge
wrapText=left: the declared side does not move the picture
column posOffset -40 pt: into the left margin, text resumes at 248
500 pt picture at margin 0: the anchor line drops below it
D1 first of two right-hugging pictures (y 78.5..207.5)
D1 second picture (y 168.5..297.5) overlaps the first by 39 pt and still sits at 365 (gen: a CSS float stacked a picture width to the left)
D3 right picture overlapping the left one vertically stays at 365
